newsitem.title: USA: Kmart consolidated May same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kmart consolidated May same-store sales up.

text.p: Kmart Corp said consolidated same-store sales for the four-week period ended May 28 increased 2.7 percent and U.S. Kmart sales increased 2.8 percent.
Results exclude sales of the discontinued Builders Square operations, Kmart said.
Total consolidated sales for the month increased 2.1 percent to $2.482 billion, compared with $2.431 billion for the same period last year.
Sales from consolidated operations for the 17 weeks ended May 28 were $9.745 billion, up 3.6 percent from $9.406 billion for the first 17 weeks of 1996.
On a same-store basis, consolidated sales rose 4.7 percent for the same period and U.S. Kmart sales rose 4.9 percent.
"Kmart's sales for the month were below plan due primarily to cold weather," said chief executive Floyd Hall.

"This affected sales of seasonal goods such as selected apparel, horticulture, and camping. Performance in our Martha Stewart Everyday domestics continued strong. Other areas showing particular strength for the month included children's apparel, sporting goods, home electronics, consumables, housewares, health and beauty accessories, and photography," Hall said.
Kmart has 2,122 Kmart retail outlets in the United States, and operates 123 stores internationally.
